description: This file contains unit tests for the AccessFlowStateMachineDao class within the OrangeHRM core plugin. It verifies various database operations related to workflow state transitions, including retrieving allowed actions, getting next states, checking permissions, and handling user role renaming.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the methods of AccessFlowStateMachineDao, focusing on workflow state management in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForExistingAction
methods.description: Verifies that allowed actions are correctly retrieved for a valid existing action.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForNonExistingAction
methods.description: Verifies that null is returned when querying for allowed actions with invalid data.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForExistingState
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of the next state for a valid current state.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForInvalidState
methods.description: Checks behavior when an invalid current state is provided.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of actionable states for a given role and actions.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests saving a new workflow state machine record to the database.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion of a specific workflow state machine record.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Checks retrieval of workflow state machine records for a given workflow.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsNullWorkflow
methods.description: Verifies behavior when retrieving records for a non-existent workflow.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowed
methods.description: Tests whether a specific action is allowed under certain conditions.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedForNonEntry
methods.description: Verifies boolean return for non-entry actions.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsExisting
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of allowed workflow items for existing states.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsAllStates
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all workflow items when no specific state is provided.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsNotExisting
methods.description: Verifies behavior when querying for a non-existent role.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific workflow item based on state, action, and role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Verifies deletion of workflow records for a specific role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRoleAllWorkflows
methods.description: Checks bulk deletion across all workflows for a role.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Tests updating workflow records when a user role is renamed.
